mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Fireman Park with a temperature of 75 degrees under a new moon.

City Hall has released notices regarding the fall partisan primary and November elections. Additionally, road improvements on Highway M are set to begin August 18, which will involve lane shifts and utility work lasting a few weeks.

Today you can enjoy the downtown Farmer Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory, or yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, be sure to head to Century School Park for the free Concerts in the Park.
Regarding recent activity, on August 8, a Verona Police Department drone pilot helped law enforcement track down a suspect in a cornfield following a burglary in the Town of Christiana.
Culver's of Verona is serving up the delightful Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day and will remain open for you to visit until 10 PM tonight.
